articles.summary: - Phase 3 CALIBRATE primary results were presented in an oral presentation at the 2026 ECE, demonstrating the rapid and durable benefit of encaleret across key clinical parameters in ADH1 - All pre-specified primary and key secondary efficacy endpoints were met in the Phase 3 CALIBRATE trial; 76% of participants administered encaleret achieved both serum and urine calcium within the respective target ranges at Week 24 compared to 4% when on conventional therapy at Week 4 (p<0.0001) - Encaleret may be eligible for priority review; BridgeBio anticipates U.S. launch in early 2027 - If approved, encaleret could be the first approved therapy specifically indicated for individuals living with ADH1 - BridgeBio also intends to initiate the RECLAIM-HP Phase 3 clinical study of encaleret in chronic hypoparathyroidism in Summer 2026 PALO ALTO, Calif., May 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BridgeBio Pharma, Inc. articles.title: BridgeBio Submits NDA to FDA for Encaleret for Individuals Living with ADH1
